incoming.name: Hannibal Barca
incoming.excerpt: In fact, his exploits (especially his victory at Cannae) continue to be studied in several military academies all over the world.

outgoing.name: Libya
outgoing.excerpt: Hannibal's better infantry (Libyan- Phoenician mercenaries) were positioned just inside his cavalry on the wings at the very edge of his infantry line.
